Services agreement: Money Made Simple at Work

Between {{YOUR_BUSINESS_NAME}}, {{YOUR_ADDRESS}} (the "Provider"), and {{CLIENT_LEGAL_NAME}}, {{CLIENT_ADDRESS}} (the "Client"). Effective {{START_DATE}}.

  1. Services. The Provider supplies white-label employee financial education branded for the Client: one issue a month, each with employee email (HTML and text), intranet or chat post with image, breakroom slide; flyer and manager talking points on Growth and above. Plan: {{PLAN}}. Each issue is delivered at least 14 days before its scheduled date.
  2. Review and approval. The Client reviews each issue and may request edits; the Provider makes reasonable edits within 1 business day. Nothing is used until the Client approves it in writing (email is enough). Silence is not approval.
  3. The Client sends it. The Client distributes each issue to its employees from its own systems. The Provider sends nothing on the Client's behalf and receives no personal data about its employees. Content is general education only. Plan details (retirement plan, match, EAP) appear only in the Client's own wording, and the Client confirms them. Nothing is investment, tax or legal advice, and the Provider never sees employee data. Where a broker refers the Client, any referral fee is disclosed in writing.
  4. Fees. Monthly fee: {{FEE}} per month, invoiced {{BILLING: monthly in advance / annually}}, due within 30 days of invoice. {{PILOT_TERMS_OR_DELETE: e.g. the first 2 months are free under the founding pilot.}} Prices are fixed for 12 months from the effective date.
  5. Term and ending it. This agreement runs month to month. Either party may end it with 30 days' written notice. Fees for issues already delivered remain due; nothing else is owed.
  6. Content license. The Provider owns the content and grants the Client a non-exclusive license to use, edit and distribute each delivered issue to its employees, under the Client's brand, during the term and afterward for issues delivered while the agreement was in force. The Client may not resell or relicense the content to others.
  7. The Client's brand. The Client grants the Provider a limited license to use its name, logo and supplied details only to produce the Client's issues. The Provider will not name the Client as a customer without written permission.
  8. Accuracy and AI disclosure. Each issue is general education, not financial, tax, legal or investment advice. The Provider drafts content with AI help, and a person checks every fact against the cited public sources before delivery. Each issue carries a short AI disclosure, which the Client may reword but not remove. If a fact turns out wrong, the Provider sends a correction promptly at no charge.
  9. No guarantees, and a cap. The Provider doesn't promise any result (for example, fewer fraud losses or enrollments). Except for a party's gross negligence or willful misconduct, each party's total liability under this agreement is limited to the fees paid in the 3 months before the claim, and neither party is liable for indirect or consequential damages.
  10. General. The Provider is an independent contractor. This is the whole agreement, and changes must be in writing and signed by both. {{GOVERNING_STATE}} law governs. Notices go to the emails below.
